items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 31:1
items.html: The choicest of the lights, the sparks, and the vessels of Nekudim was corrected first in Atzilut. There are three discernments in this matter. The first is that the higher one is the more choice. The second is that the vessels of GAR are more choice than the vessels of VAK, in the way explained in the Inner Observation here (Item 7, Sub Header, “And here you”). The third is according to the three divisions of Nekudim: Achor be'Achor, Panim be'Achor, and Panim be'Panim, as written here in Inner Light, p. 616, Sub Header, “And at first.” (p. 624, Sub Header, “And with this you will understand”)
